import random, sys, time, importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("main", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
main = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(main)
from kf import ktree_factors
seed=int(sys.argv[1]); trials=int(sys.argv[2]); mlo=int(sys.argv[3]); mhi=int(sys.argv[4])
rng=random.Random(seed)
bad=0; tmax=0; tnaive=0
for tr in range(trials):
    m=rng.randint(mlo,mhi)
    factors, order = ktree_factors(rng, m, k=4, zero_prob=0.25)
    red = main.reduce_factors(factors)
    if red is None: continue
    t0=time.perf_counter()
    Z, marg = main.infer_joint(red, order, m)
    t1=time.perf_counter()
    if Z==0: continue
    Zn = main.partition_value(red, order)
    margn = main.naive_marginals(red, order, m)
    t2=time.perf_counter()
    tmax=max(tmax, t1-t0); tnaive=max(tnaive, t2-t1)
    if Z!=Zn: bad+=1; print("Z mismatch", Z, Zn); break
    for v in range(m):
        s=sum(marg[v])
        if s!=Z: bad+=1; print("sum mismatch", v, s, Z); break
        for t in range(3):
            if marg[v][t]!=margn[v][t]:
                bad+=1; print("marg mismatch", m, v, t, marg[v], margn[v]); break
    if bad: print("factors", factors); break
    if tr%10==0: print("trial",tr,"m",m,"jt %.3fs naive %.3fs"%(t1-t0,t2-t1), "Zbits", Z.bit_length())
print("done trials",trials,"bad",bad,"max jt",round(tmax,3),"max naive",round(tnaive,3))
EOF
